source_name: Weld County BOCC Laserfiche WebLink: Tax Incentive Agreements (C.R.S. 30-11-123) and Commissioner Records
publisher: Weld County Board of County Commissioners, Clerk to the Board
jurisdiction_covered: All of Weld County (the county incentive is available to facilities inside cities too)
source_type: Local incentives: county personal property tax incentive agreements, resolutions, agreements, packets, minutes
what_it_tells_you: Every BOCC document since 1859 with a Commissioner Records template: Document ID, Packet Type, DocCode (AGRMT, RESO, APPL, DTRM, ORD and so on), Hearing Date, Notes and a Names field that carries the company name. Tax Incentive Agreements under C.R.S. 30-11-123 name the taxpayer, the facility address, the phasing plan and a cap on incentive payments for qualifying manufacturing equipment and machinery. Also carries Small Business Incentive Program applications, USR and 1041 hearing determinations, contracts and resolutions.
facility_link_method: Names field (company); facility address and phase plan in the OCR text of the agreement (pages 2 and 3); cross-walk to Assessor Sales and Ownership tables by company name
chain_link: Incentive award, capex approval (the agreement is only worth signing if large equipment purchases are planned)
how_early_it_fires: 6 to 20 months before the plant opens. Hirsh Precision Feb 2022 (plant opened Oct 2023); Sphere Renewables Dec 2022 (ribbon cutting June 2024); Agilent Dec 2022 (groundbreaking Feb 2023); Colorado Premium Jul 2023 (opened Feb 2024); TFP Nutrition Oct 2024 (announced Nov 2025); BAE Systems Sep 16 2026 (building bought Oct 5 2026, press Oct 23 2026).
access_method: JSON services with a session cookie: POST /WebLink/FolderListingService.aspx/GetFolderListing2 (folders BOCC > year > month > meeting date > Document ID), POST /WebLink/FolderListingService.aspx/GetMetaData (template fields), POST /WebLink/SearchService.aspx/GetSearchListing with searchSyn such as {[Commissioner Records]:[Notes]="*TAX INCENTIVE*"} & {[Commissioner Records]:[Hearing Date]>="1/1/2022"}, POST /WebLink/DocumentService.aspx/GetTextHtmlForPage for OCR text per page. The LF:Basic full text search timed out; field searches return in seconds.
format: JSON (listing and metadata), OCR text per page, page images; no direct PDF URL found
automation_blocked: No robots.txt (404); CookieCheck redirect requires a cookie jar; JSON endpoints answered curl and Python
terms_commercial_use: Portal disclaimer is liability only (developed for internal use and made available to the public; no warranty). No commercial use restriction stated.
verification_notes: Walked the folder tree to the 2026-11-09 meeting; ran Names and Notes field searches; pulled metadata for 60 documents; read OCR text of the BAE Systems agreement (5 pages).
industrial_example_seen: Tax Incentive Agreements 2022 to 2026: GG Colorado II, Colorado Stud Company, Hirsh Precision Products, Sphere Renewables, Norfolk Iron and Metal, Agilent Technologies, Airxcel and Aqua-Hot, K2D and Colorado Premium Foods, Microvast Energy, Owens-Brockway Glass Container, Texas Farm Products and TFP Nutrition, North American Machines of Colorado and TruLog Siding, Charm Industrial, The Scotts Company and Hyponex, EcoMod, US Engineering Metalworks, Motherload Co Packing, BAE Systems Space and Mission Systems (Project Mercury, 4120 Specialty Place, three phases, Phase I cap $13.77M).
key_fields: entryId, Document ID, Packet Type, DocCode, Document Type, Hearing Date, Scan Date, Notes, Names, path, OCR text
recommended_next_step: Build first. Search DocCode AGRMT with Notes containing TAX INCENTIVE or 30-11-123 and Notes containing SMALL BUSINESS INCENTIVE, pull metadata and OCR text for the agreement pages, extract taxpayer, facility address and phase caps. Also snapshot every new meeting folder weekly and flag Names that match industrial keywords.
